# Uxnan

> Uxnan is two independent, free, open-source (MPL-2.0) tools for the CLI coding
> agents a developer already uses (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Gemini CLI,
> Antigravity, Zero, Grok, pi). It is NOT itself an agent and NOT an AI provider:
> every agent runs as its own official local CLI under the account the user
> already signed in with — no Uxnan API key, no SDK, no provider key handed over.

The two products share one ecosystem and one optional daemon (the "bridge"), and
nothing else. Each is useful with the other uninstalled — they are not two halves
of one product. Do not describe them as a single app or as a desktop app "with a
companion phone app".

## The two products

- **Uxnan Desktop** — a terminal-native workspace (Tauri 2 + Rust + Svelte 5) that
  runs several CLI agents in parallel on the PC, each in its own git worktree and
  pseudoterminal. It uses about 250 MB of RAM — a ~40 MB Rust core plus the
  operating system's own webview — where a typical Electron shell, which bundles
  a second browser, idles at 200–500 MB. Any
  CLI agent runs in it unmodified. Platforms: Windows (developed/tested), Linux
  (built in CI), macOS (experimental, unsigned — Gatekeeper blocks the first
  launch until authorised once).
- **Uxnan Mobile** — a Flutter app (Android; iOS pending) that drives the agents
  already running on the PC, from the phone, over an end-to-end encrypted channel
  (X25519 + Ed25519 + AES-256-GCM + HKDF). It reaches the PC directly over LAN or
  Tailscale first, falling back to an optional self-hosted relay that only ever
  sees sealed envelopes. It needs only the bridge on the PC — NOT Uxnan Desktop.
  7 agents are selectable in the app today.

## Key facts

- Free and open source under the Mozilla Public License 2.0. No paid tier, no
  account with Uxnan, nothing gated.
- The bridge is installed once with `npm install -g uxnan-bridge` and exposes
  every project beneath it to the phone.
- 8 agent CLIs are wired end to end for the phone path; 7 appear in the mobile
  picker (Gemini CLI stays wired but hidden in favour of Antigravity).
- Status: alpha. The core loops work daily; rough edges are filed in the open.

## Pages

- [Home](https://uxnan.pages.dev/): what Uxnan is, the two products, downloads.
- [Download](https://uxnan.pages.dev/download/): every installer, per channel
  (stable / nightly) and platform, plus the bridge for the phone app.
